code: (()=>{const E=window.__echoes;E.cmd("startRun");E.cmd("skipToRoom",8);const b=E.cmd("runState").boss;window.__ybid=b.id;window.__ys={hits:[],absorb:[],adds:[],hp:[],nums:[],other:[]};for(const t of ["boss_absorb","boss_seal_start","boss_seal_break","boss_sealed","boss_shield"])E.on(t,ev=>window.__ys.absorb.push(t+" t"+ev.tick+" "+JSON.stringify(ev).slice(0,120)));E.on("boss_adds",ev=>window.__ys.adds.push({tick:ev.tick,pct:ev.pct,spawned:ev.spawned}));E.on("hit",ev=>{if(ev.target===window.__ybid)window.__ys.hits.push({tick:ev.tick,amount:ev.amount,crit:ev.crit,src:ev.source});});const seen=new WeakMap();window.__ysHp=setInterval(()=>{const bb=E.cmd("runState").boss;if(bb)window.__ys.hp.push([E.tick,Math.round(bb.hp*100)/100]);for(const n of document.querySelectorAll("#dmg-num-layer *")){if(!n.offsetParent||!n.textContent.trim())continue;const key=n.textContent.trim();if(seen.get(n)===key)continue;seen.set(n,key);const r=n.getBoundingClientRect();window.__ys.nums.push({tick:E.tick,txt:key,cls:n.className,x:Math.round(r.x),y:Math.round(r.y)});}},25);return {bossId:b.id,hp:b.hp,tick:E.tick,keys:Object.keys(b)};})()
